commands.name: ApplyAcceptedRfcSourceProjection
commands.visibility: internal cross-packet command invoked by LLD-04 accepted reconciliation; not a raw workbook route
input: accepted LLD-04 RFC reconciliation proposal with exact RFC/base/evidence/review bindings
parent command_context carrying outer command_id/hash and already-inserted parent command_receipt
steps: inside the shared UoW require the LLD-04 parent command receipt already exists, then load exact RFC/current projection/hierarchy and revalidate current owner state
validate accepted evidence identities and LLD-04 precedence through RfcSourceEvidenceProvider
determine the exact current-field changes and any terminal-epoch/cascade effect
apply only accepted usable current field changes using the parent command context for provenance; LLD-03 inserts no command receipt
for transition into terminal allocate terminal_epoch_id and atomically capture/insert exact pending cascade proposal and immutable RFC/WFM membership
for terminal reversal require exact fresh high-risk review, clear current terminal epoch and supersede any still-pending proposal for that epoch without undoing executed history
append minimal LLD-03 audit/result references and return RfcLifecycleProjectionV1 to the LLD-04 coordinator without nested commit
rules: LLD-04 AcceptReconciliationProposal exclusively owns replay resolution, command_id/hash authority, the single command receipt and the outer commit for this shared UnitOfWork
source acceptance never overwrites RFC hierarchy, SR links, Device Reference links, Working Notes, archive state or canonical Customer without their governed commands
terminal evidence acceptance never executes Task/Objective/Communication cascade consequences
unchanged current accepted fields produce semantic NO_CHANGE at field level and no duplicate current-history authority

commands.name: RefreshRfcTerminalCascadeProposal
commands.response: RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1 exact persisted state produced inside the owning writer UnitOfWork; NO_CHANGE returns the unchanged pending state, material refresh returns the replacement pending state
steps: inside UoW prove proposal is pending at the exact base revision and trigger RFC still has the same terminal_epoch_id as the proposal

load the current accepted terminal status class/evidence for that epoch; Closed<->Cancelled correction is allowed and becomes the replacement terminal binding, while nonterminal/reversed or different-epoch state is stale and cannot be refreshed
capture current exact RFC/WFM scope using the current accepted terminal class/evidence and compute SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_SCOPE_V1 replacement fingerprint
if terminal class/evidence and complete scope fingerprint are all unchanged from the pending proposal return semantic NO_CHANGE with the exact unchanged RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1

insert receipt, supersede old proposal with immutable provenance, insert replacement pending proposal/member rows using the same terminal epoch and current terminal class/evidence, audit refresh, persist the exact replacement RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1 command result, commit
rules: refresh never executes downstream consequences
executed or already superseded proposal cannot be refreshed
refresh never edits proposal identity/evidence/fingerprint/member rows in place
terminal evidence correction within the same epoch is a material refresh even when RFC/WFM membership is unchanged
refresh never invokes PreviewRfcTerminalCascade inside its writer UnitOfWork; cross-domain impact preview remains the separate read-only route and is requested after refresh when needed

commands.name: ExecuteRfcTerminalCascade
commands.response: RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1 exact persisted executed state from the owning writer UnitOfWork; same command_id exact replay returns this original result before proof validation, owner preparation or current-state reads
steps: resolve exact LLD-01 command replay before owner preparation, proof validation or current-state reads; a successful replay returns the original committed RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1 and never consumes another deliberate-action proof
inside one writer UnitOfWork reload the proposal and require it remains pending at the exact base proposal revision
revalidate that the triggering RFC remains in the exact proposal terminal_epoch_id with the exact current terminal status class/evidence captured by the proposal

recompute the complete current RFC/WFM scope using the accepted terminal binding and require exact equality with the proposal SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_SCOPE_V1 fingerprint and persisted member authority

call LLD-05 RfcTerminalTaskParticipant.revalidate_terminal_cascade(uow,proposal_snapshot,execution_review.task_objective_exact_count,execution_review.task_objective_provider_fingerprint); STALE returns RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_STALE and INDETERMINATE returns RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PARTICIPANT_FAILED, with no proof consumption or cascade mutation

call LLD-09 RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant.revalidate_terminal_cascade(uow,proposal_snapshot,execution_review.communication_exact_count,execution_review.communication_provider_fingerprint) under the same rules

after both providers return READY reconstruct the exact current SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PREVIEW_V1 from the pending proposal revision, identical persisted/current scope facts, empty stale reasons and the provider summaries certified equal by revalidation; require its digest exactly equals execution_review.preview_fingerprint or return RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_STALE

only after all domain freshness checks pass call LLD-12 DeliberateActionProofProvider.validate_and_consume(uow,proof,'tickets.rfc.terminal_cascade.execute',DeliberateActionTargetV1{target_type:'rfc_terminal_cascade_proposal',target_id:proposal_id},base_revision,execution_review.preview_fingerprint); any action/target/revision/preview/session/expiry/single-use mismatch returns RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED with no cascade mutation
insert the single command receipt before participant/domain rows can reference command_id; rollback removes it on participant failure

construct RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionCommandContextV1 with the outer command_id, actor binding and accepted execution_review.preview_fingerprint; it contains no proof/session secret and is not an authorization grant

invoke LLD-05 Task/Objective apply_terminal_cascade and LLD-09 Communication apply_terminal_cascade using the same UnitOfWork, already-revalidated proposal snapshot and the explicit command context; each participant requires the outer receipt, persists its exact provider-owned consequence/history/audit rows, and returns one bounded RfcTerminalCascadeParticipantApplyResultV1

validate each participant apply summary has its exact expected domain, nonnegative exact result/audit counts and lowercase result_fingerprint; never copy the participant's complete result-ref/history set into LLD-03

if either participant apply or summary validation fails, roll back all database effects and keep the proposal pending; the consumed deliberate proof remains single-use per LLD-12 and the operator repeats the deliberate action before retry

transition the proposal pending->executed exactly once, append the bounded LLD-03 audit containing reviewed preview fingerprint plus the two participant apply summaries, persist the exact RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1 command response and commit atomically
rules: the committed Task/Objective and Communication consequences must be exactly the consequences whose complete provider fingerprints/counts were reviewed; unchanged RFC/WFM scope alone is insufficient execution authority
provider revalidation is read-only, complete-set and same-UoW; no impact rows or provider-owned domain objects are copied into LLD-03

provider apply consequences/history/audit remain authoritative in LLD-05/LLD-09 and may have arbitrary valid cardinality; LLD-03 receives only fixed-shape RfcTerminalCascadeParticipantApplyResultV1 correlation summaries, so audit transport does not create a business cap
participant result_fingerprint is post-apply correlation evidence over complete provider-owned result/audit identities and is never substituted for the pre-apply provider revalidation authority
deliberate proof is friction evidence only and never authorizes an otherwise stale, ineligible or indeterminate business operation
proof validation/consumption occurs only after proposal, terminal, scope and both provider-impact freshness checks have succeeded
safe auto-accept cannot call this command
SRs and unrelated Local Tasks are never cascade targets
provider WFM source evidence is never rewritten

commands.name: ArchiveRfc
steps: inside UoW recalculate exact requested scope and require reviewed fingerprint/revisions still match
identify active members that will change and already-archived members that remain untouched
if no member changes return semantic NO_CHANGE
allocate archive operation ID and insert receipt/operation row
transition only active reviewed members to archived and increment revision
insert immutable operation membership plus archived event for each changed member using resulting RFC revision as event order
audit exact changes and commit
rules: archive affects RFC local presentation only
pre-existing archived members are never claimed by this operation
branch archive requires explicit exact preview

commands.name: RestoreRfcArchiveOperation
steps: inside UoW load immutable operation membership
for each member read current archive state and latest-by-resulting-revision archive event
select only members still archived by this exact origin operation; later restored/rearchived members are excluded
if no member remains eligible return semantic NO_CHANGE
insert receipt, transition eligible members to active/increment revision, append restored events with resulting revisions referencing origin operation, audit per-member outcomes, commit
rules: restore never activates a member this operation did not itself archive
source lifecycle/status and downstream domains remain untouched

commands.name: HardDeleteRfc
steps: inside UoW load exact RFC/revision and recompute every hard-delete eligibility guard/provider token from current state
require the recomputed eligible fingerprint matches the reviewed preview and no blocker/INDETERMINATE exists
insert command receipt

append the minimal RFC hard-delete audit event while the target identity/business number are still available; this current command evidence is excluded from the pre-command untouched-history predicate
delete the RFC row only; no generic cascade is used and any unexpected dependent FK causes rollback
commit
rules: only a provably untouched manual draft is eligible
accepted source/provisional adoption, hierarchy/SR/Device/Note/WFM/Task/Objective/Communication/Inventory/archive/correction history blocks deletion
creation audit does not by itself make a never-used manual draft undeletable; any post-creation protected activity does
there are no default local child rows silently deleted to manufacture eligibility
ordinary history-bearing RFCs use archive/terminal/correction flows
